Callout.Name: Suspicious Trailer
Callout.Message: Trailer on a back road with a chemical smell.

Script.Line: There is a trailer parked on the verge and nobody in it.
The smell is coming off it. You can smell it from the road.
There is a generator running inside it. That is what I can hear.

Lines.Approach: Generator going and a smell that is not farmyard. Nobody about.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
